name: FlyingThings3D
description: A large synthetic stereo-video dataset with optical-flow, disparity, and scene-flow annotations, rendered from varied 3D scenes for training and evaluation.
citation: Mayer, N., Ilg, E., Häusser, P., Fischer, P., Cremers, D., Dosovitskiy, A., and Brox, T. (2016).
